notes: The UC contract list is open and reachable. It shows the Illumina agreement (CalUsource 2023003585) effective 2/15/2024 and expiring 6/14/2029. The PacBio agreement (2023003817) runs 2/1/2024 to 1/31/2029. Element is not listed. The April 9, 2024 UC announcement gives only '25% off service agreements' and unspecified discounts on product categories. It gives no X consumable discount, no tiers and no renewal terms. Both contracts predate 2025, so there was no 2025-26 renewal and no sign that discounts deepened. The pages are summaries only. I made 2 fetches, and the Illumina agreement's actual terms are not public. I did not use archive.ph, because the live pages show no change history.
how_to_mine: Not worth a deep extraction. A California Public Records Act request for contract 2023003585 would be the only route to the discount schedule, and I did not try it. Other UC campus pages may list the UC-wide Illumina price schedule, but I did not check, and login is likely required.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: The UC system-wide Illumina agreement locks in a long, multi-year discount framework (Feb 2024 to Jun 2029), including a 25% service discount.
items.detail: The UC-wide Illumina agreement (CalUsource 2023003585) runs 2/15/2024 to 6/14/2029 and covers instruments, reagents, service agreements and research services. The only quantified term is 25% off service agreements. Consumable discounts are unspecified and no tiers are published. This shows large academic buyers pool purchasing, but it does not show deepening discounts.
items.source_name: UC Office of the President Procurement
items.why_new: The UC system-wide contract, its dates and the 25% service discount were not in the known evidence.
